extraction.title: Imported enthusiasm
extraction.subtitle: Chinamaxxing is starting to catch on, in China It’s a boon for the tourist trade
extraction.summary: The phenomenon of 'Chinamaxxing' is boosting China's tourism and economy, driven by foreign social media endorsements and a new visa-free entry program. While initial excitement has led to increased foreign visits and spending, the long-term sustainability of this trend remains uncertain.

events.event_summary: Foreign tourism to China begins to recover post-pandemic, with over 35 million visitors recorded.
Huangshan reports doubling of foreign tourist spending in the first nine months of 2025 due to social media exposure.

narratives.thesis: While Chinamaxxing has led to short-term economic benefits, its long-term impact on tourism and local economies is uncertain.
